row.body: The café’s cup count is complete, but the plaza key is listed as returned before the shop’s closing receipt.
row.title: The plaza cup return

sidecar.gloss: A plaza key returns before the café closes.
sidecar.rival_reading: A maintenance worker could return the key early while the shop stayed open; the record does not identify why.

row.body: chalk numbers run across the black pen and bath towel. the count skips one place, then resumes in a different hand.
row.title: missing count beside the black pen

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
